europe_now.title: Russian Missiles Hit Poland and Massive Strikes Pummel Ukraine
europe_now.summary: Russian cruise missiles crossed into Poland and widespread strikes hit Ukraine during intensive regional attacks. Authorities in Poland also stated they successfully prevented a separate false-flag operation near the border.

sources.headline: Russian cruise missiles land in Poland, drones explode over EU diplomats in Kyiv (Ukraine Battlefield update, Day 1,730)

europe_now.title: EU and UK Conclude Landmark Agreement to Reset Relations
europe_now.summary: European and British leaders hailed a turning point in bilateral relations following a high-level summit in Brussels. The new agreements address post-Brexit alignment across areas including food standards, carbon markets, and youth mobility.

sources.headline: UK and EU strike ‘landmark’ deal to rebuild ties after Brexit

top_stories.title: Regional Security and Cross-Border Incidents
top_stories.summary: Russian military strikes caused significant impact across the region with missile hits reported in both Ukraine and Poland. Security officials reported that coordinated defensive measures were implemented along affected European borders.

top_stories.title: EU-UK Diplomatic Engagement
top_stories.summary: European Union and British representatives finalized a major summit deal in Brussels to mend ties following years of post-Brexit separation. The comprehensive arrangement covers cooperation on economic frameworks, environmental regulations, and travel provisions.

top_stories.title: Cost of Living Protests and Economic Pressure
top_stories.summary: Demonstrations regarding cost of living concerns expanded across multiple European nations including Spain and Italy. Citizens voiced widespread frustration over economic hardships and financial pressures despite broader national growth figures.
